findings.interpretation: Ranked selection improved the offline syntax/valid-tool-call and recorded-suffix NLL diagnostics, but substantially increased repeated known failures and did not improve first-action reference agreement. It is not a promising recovery-selection signal under this diagnostic.

limitations: Offline metrics are not environment task success.
No official test, formal evaluator, Pilot, or paper conclusion is authorized.
next_design_recommendation: Do not promote the current forced-first contrast rank as a formal selector.
In a future formal continuous-runtime experiment, add an explicit repeated-failure penalty/exclusion to selector scoring and preregister end-to-end task success as the primary endpoint.
Keep random stratified selection as the exploratory comparator.
